source_read: https://atis.life/bowls-plates-sides and https://atis.life/wraps (read 2026-10-11; robots.txt of atis.life (200): Allow /, Disallow /admin, no crawler groups); section totals confirmed against https://atis.life/api/en/products?collections=<id>&page=1 (the feed behind each Load more button: totals 2, 4, 4, 5, 4 = the 19 dishes on the pages); site count from https://atis.life/locations
not_verifiable: allergens and vegetarian/vegan marks: the page data holds lists per dish that no page shows (the FAQ points to a PDF allergen guide on an S3 host whose robots.txt answers 403), so none are published. Build-your-own bowls and drinks: their figures are only in PDF guides on that S3 host, not fetched.
notes: Second method: the page was rendered in Chromium (JavaScript on, only atis.life requests allowed) and the visible text of every dish card (title, then CALORIES / PROTEIN / CARBS / FAT) was walked line by line, without the JSON the script parses: 19 dishes read, the 16 published ones all equal to items.csv. The 3 not published are as printed: Blackened Chicken Pot prints ranges (330 - 414 kcal, 38 - 47G protein), Roasted Heritage Carrots Pot (192) and Kale Harvest Side Pot (256) print calories only. The rendered /locations page lists the same 16 sites as the page data (Old Street, Borough Yards, Notting Hill, Canary Wharf, Eastcheap, Moorgate, Eccleston Yards, Regent Street, Covent Garden, Mayfair, Battersea, Southbank, North Audley Street, Kings Cross, Baker Street, St James Park; none marked coming soon). Marked OK: Chipotle Chilli Salmon prints 787 kcal with 36 g protein, 22 g carbs, 42 g fat (macros give 610, 22% off): confirmed as printed on the card, published with the check warning. 'Blackened Chicken Ceasar' is the page's own spelling.
